executive_summary.primary_bottleneck: High monthly churn (8.5%) and low net revenue retention (88%)
key_findings: Net revenue retention at 88% indicates revenue leakage
executive_summary.strategic_thesis: Implement repeatable, low‑code retention systems to activate at‑risk users and curb churn before expanding acquisition spend
executive_summary.primary_30_day_objective: Reduce monthly churn from 8.5% to ≤6.5% and lift activation rate to 30% through automated nurture, in‑app prompts, and a referral loop
assumptions: Team of 3 can adopt no‑code tools (email automation, in‑app config)
Limited engineering means solutions must use existing product configuration

prioritized_growth_channels.rationale: Directly addresses churn by educating and re‑engaging users during the first weeks of the product experience
prioritized_growth_channels.system_to_build: Trigger‑based email workflow (welcome, feature highlights, usage tips) using a no‑code platform
prioritized_growth_channels.leading_kpi: Email activation rate (users who perform a core action after receiving email)

prioritized_growth_channels.rationale: Leverages satisfied customers to generate warm leads and reinforces commitment, indirectly reducing churn
supporting_evidence: High churn indicates need for stronger customer advocacy
Existing organic channels (LinkedIn, search) provide traffic base
prioritized_growth_channels.system_to_build: Automated referral portal with reward tracking integrated via a no‑code referral app
prioritized_growth_channels.leading_kpi: Number of referral sign‑ups per week
risks: Referral rewards cost outweigh acquisition value

prioritized_growth_channels.rationale: Guides users to high‑value features, improving product stickiness and lowering churn risk
prioritized_growth_channels.system_to_build: Rule‑based tooltip triggers that surface contextual tips for key workflows
prioritized_growth_channels.leading_kpi: Feature adoption rate (users who complete target action)
prioritized_growth_channels.target: 50% of active users adopt core feature within 7 days of prompt

action_plan_30_days.objective: Map churn drivers and establish tracking

actions.task: Conduct churn cohort analysis and identify high‑risk segments
Implement product usage event tracking for key features
actions.success_metric: All events visible in analytics dashboard

actions.task: Design and build email nurture workflow in Mailchimp
Configure in‑app tooltip triggers for core workflow
Develop referral program landing page and reward structure
actions.success_metric: Referral page published and linked in email footer

action_plan_30_days.objective: Deploy systems to target users and gather leading metrics

actions.task: Launch email nurture to 20% of new sign‑ups
Activate in‑app nudges for all new users
Send referral invitation emails to existing customers

action_plan_30_days.objective: Assess impact, refine systems, and document SOPs

actions.task: Analyze churn and activation metrics post‑intervention
actions.success_metric: Churn reduced by ≥1 pp and activation ≥30%

actions.task: A/B test email subject lines and iterate sequence based on results
Document SOPs for email, tooltip, and referral systems
